notes.tail: F-35I Adir 921 of 140 Squadron in a public photo (the squadron's tail art, 2021): one real jet of the squadron, the pilot's in the sim
notes.max_takeoff_kg: the F-35A's maximum weight, 70,000 lb class (31,751 kg), Lockheed Martin's; the F-35I's is not published (inferred the same)
notes.type: type codes from 1000 are ours (docs/adding-a-plane.md §1); 1000 is the F-35I's
notes.model: none: the player's jet is drawn from its airframe definition (shared/extra/planes/f35i/airframe.json)
notes.scale: 1: our models are built true size
notes.strength: our damage scale's fighter (modern-iaf/docs/data-formats.md, damage scale)
notes.loadout.20mm: GAU-22/A 25 mm, 180 rounds; the 20 mm record stands in for it, as in the airframe definition
notes.loadout.chaff: no public count found; 60 held until one is
notes.loadout.flare: no public count found; 60 held until one is
notes.stations: the F-35A's eleven stations, numbered from the left wing tip: 1 / 11 the outboard wing pylons (the AIM-9X's), 2 / 10 the middle and 3 / 9 the inboard wing pylons, 4 / 8 the bays' outboard (air-to-ground, up to 2,500 lb) and 5 / 7 their inboard stations (air-to-air), 6 the centreline (a gun pod on the F-35B / C only, left out); each mapped to the engine's pylon letter (A..I: the armament holds nine), as player_aircraft.gd f35i_object and docs/f35i.md §3.1 do; 2 and 10 have none (empty: ''), so they carry nothing in the sim
notes.internal: the two bays' four stations, inside the fuselage: their stores add no drag
notes.pylons: the training's defensive pair: an AIM-120 on each bay's inboard, air-to-air station (5 and 7, D and F), the bays' air-to-ground stations 4 and 8 empty, no external stores (a stealthy jet's; inferred for the training)
notes.inventory: the stores the briefing lists as the Adir's: the AIM-120 (the bays' inboard stations) and the GBU-31 JDAM (their outboard ones; the MK-84 record stands in, modern_weapons.gd builds the GBU-31 on it); no counts published
